claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM for 5 days, this glucocorticoid receptor agonist is expected to produce little or no direct cytotoxicity; any antiproliferative effect would be modest and context-dependent, likely reflecting GR-mediated growth inhibition in lymphoid-lineage lines rather than a broad cytotoxic mechanism.
